verdict.rationale: INPI's own site publishes a guide for online trademark and logo applications, which directly indicates the core filing transaction can be done online. It also documents requesting title issuance online. The evidence is only a guide title, though: no published page shows the end-to-end online submission and fee payment, and online filing for patents, utility models or designs is not stated. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end online filing with payment, explicit online filing for patents/designs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages
